claude.result:
The changes are complete and all tests pass. The implementation adds full weekly subscription support to subtrack with:

- **Weekly billing cycle**: `--every week` option works alongside month and year
- **Correct monthly calculation**: €price × 52 ÷ 12, rounded to nearest cent (e.g., €12/week = €52/month)
- **7-day renewal cycle**: Weekly plans charge every 7 days from their first charge date
- **Full CLI integration**: Works with `add`, `list`, `total`, `renewals`, and `export` commands
- **Bug fix**: Also fixed renewal sorting to use actual dates instead of alphabetical labels (fixes cross-month ordering)

All 34 tests pass. The changes are ready to commit with the files modified:
- `bin/subtrack.js` - CLI support for weekly
- `src/cycles.js` - Weekly calculation logic
- `src/export.js` - CSV export support
- `src/renewals.js` - Sorting fix
